name: 낡은 나무 보물상자

request.description: A single squat CLOSED treasure chest made of dark weathered wooden planks, a gently rounded closed lid, exactly two dull iron bands following the lid and continuing down the front, and a small simple dull iron latch with a tiny padlock centered on the front. Quiet East Asian mountain-village RPG prop with HD2D readability. Desaturated dark gray-brown timber and muted warm gray/taupe iron, broad angular flat color planes, only 2-3 tones per material, crisp native pixel clusters, restrained selective colored edges without heavy black outlines. Soft light from the upper left. Straight front/south-facing low top-down orthographic camera, a small amount of the top visible; symmetrical straight-on front, no three-quarter sideways rotation. Isolated full object centered on a transparent 64x64 canvas with comfortable clear margins. A single clean readable pixel-art sprite. No gilding, jewels, open lid, contents, loot particles, floor, baked cast shadow, text, characters, sprite sheet, surrounding environment, noise, dithering, gloss.

capabilities.name: Pro Flash
capabilities.grid_recovery: Creation recovers the pixel grid the model drew with Unzoom. An exact grid is kept; drift of at most one pixel is recovered on the expected grid. Images with a background must fill the canvas, so any other size is redrawn with image-to-pixel-art on the generated box only. Sprites without a background keep their own pixels, centred on the canvas, while the drawn pixel is close to the requested one; coarser or oversized sprites are redrawn. Experimental 16x16 creation always uses image-to-pixel-art. Editing and inpainting start at 32x32 and never use image-to-pixel-art conversion.

edit.reference_image_fit: native dimensions must fit the edit canvas

character.rotation_canvas: Native source padded to a square, minimum 32 pixels, aligned to four pixels.

object.rotation_canvas: Eight views use the square V3 canvas; one direction keeps the native size.

capabilities.style_reference_fit: native dimensions must fit the target canvas; smaller references are centered without resizing

observations: 64×64 RGBA, alpha 값 0/255의 완전 투명 배경.
닫힌 짙은 목재 상자, 완만한 둥근 뚜껑, 좌우 철테 두 개, 중앙 걸쇠와 작은 자물쇠가 식별된다.
정면에서 윗면이 약간 보이는 낮은 탑다운 시점. 내용물과 환경, 그림자, 금장, 파티클 없음.
그레이브라운 목재와 밝은 회색 철테의 차분한 색감. 외곽은 짙은 선택적 가장자리, 작은 읽기 좋은 픽셀 덩어리.
실제 그림은 34×30 px로 캔버스의 일부만 차지하며 상하좌우 15 px 이상의 여백이 있다.
limitations: single direction is named unknown by PixelLab even though first_frame_direction south was requested; do not relabel original provider output as a confirmed rotation set.
공통 스타일은 텍스트로만 전달하여 기존 마을 소품과의 정확한 팔레트 일치는 확인되지 않음.
사용자 외형 채택, 게임 배치, 열린 상태, 애니메이션 검증은 범위 밖.
